segments.mn95:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena opāsādaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
segments.mn95:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā opāsāde viharati uttarena opāsādaṃ devavane sālavane.
segments.mn95:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.mn95:3.2: “samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ opāsādaṃ anuppatto, opāsāde viharati uttarena opāsādaṃ devavane sālavane.
segments.mn95:3.3: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.mn95:3.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.mn95:3.5: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
segments.mn95:3.6: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
segments.mn95:3.7: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.mn95:4.1: Atha kho opāsādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā opāsādā nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarenamukhā gacchanti yena devavanaṃ sālavanaṃ.
segments.mn95:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato.
segments.mn95:5.2: Addasā kho caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādake brāhmaṇagahapatike opāsādā nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūte uttarena mukhaṃ yena devavanaṃ sālavanaṃ tenupasaṅkamante.
segments.mn95:5.4: “kiṃ nu kho, bho khatte, opāsādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā opāsādā nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarenamukhā gacchanti yena devavanaṃ sālavanan”ti?
segments.mn95:6.1: “Atthi, bho caṅkī, samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ opāsādaṃ anuppatto, opāsāde viharati uttarena opāsādaṃ devavane sālavane.
segments.mn95:6.2: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.mn95:6.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.mn95:6.5: “Tena hi, bho khatte, yena opāsādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā opāsādake brāhmaṇagahapatike evaṃ vadehi –
segments.mn95:6.7: āgamentu kira bhonto, caṅkīpi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’”ti.
segments.mn95:6.8: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho so khatto caṅkissa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena opāsādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā opāsādake brāhmaṇagahapatike etadavoca –
segments.mn95:6.10: ‘āgamentu kira bhonto, caṅkīpi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’”ti.
segments.mn95:7.1: Tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni opāsāde paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
segments.mn95:7.3: “caṅkī kira brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti.
segments.mn95:7.4: Atha kho te brāhmaṇā yena caṅkī brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā caṅkiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn95:7.5: “saccaṃ kira bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti?
segments.mn95:8.1: “Mā bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkami.
segments.mn95:8.2: Na arahati bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:8.3: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ caṅkiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.mn95:8.4: Bhavañhi caṅkī ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
segments.mn95:8.5: Yampi bhavaṃ caṅkī ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:8.6: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ caṅkiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.mn95:8.7: Bhavañhi caṅkī aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo … pe …
segments.mn95:8.8: bhavañhi caṅkī tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo … pe …
segments.mn95:8.9: bhavañhi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī [brahmavaccasī (sī. pī.)] akhuddāvakāso dassanāya … pe …
segments.mn95:8.10: bhavañhi caṅkī sīlavā vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato … pe …
segments.mn95:8.11: bhavañhi caṅkī kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā … pe …
segments.mn95:8.12: bhavañhi caṅkī bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo, tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti … pe …
segments.mn95:8.13: bhavañhi caṅkī rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.mn95:8.14: bhavañhi caṅkī brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.mn95:8.15: bhavañhi caṅkī opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.mn95:8.16: Yampi bhavaṃ caṅkī opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ, imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:8.17: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ caṅkiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitun”ti.
segments.mn95:9.1: Evaṃ vutte, caṅkī brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca –
segments.mn95:9.2: “tena hi, bho, mamapi suṇātha, yathā mayameva arahāma taṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:9.3: natveva arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.mn95:9.4: Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
segments.mn95:9.5: Yampi, bho, samaṇo gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, imināpaṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:9.6: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ [ettha dī. ni.1.304 aññampi guṇapadaṃ dissati].
segments.mn95:9.7: Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito bhūmigatañca vehāsaṭṭhañca … pe …
segments.mn95:9.8: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo daharova samāno yuvā susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito … pe …
segments.mn95:9.9: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito … pe …
segments.mn95:9.10: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhuddāvakāso dassanāya … pe …
segments.mn95:9.11: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalena sīlena samannāgato … pe …
segments.mn95:9.12: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā … pe …
segments.mn95:9.13: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo … pe …
segments.mn95:9.14: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo khīṇakāmarāgo vigatacāpallo … pe …
segments.mn95:9.15: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo kammavādī kiriyavādī apāpapurekkhāro brahmaññāya pajāya … pe …
segments.mn95:9.16: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo uccā kulā pabbajito asambhinnā khattiyakulā … pe …
segments.mn95:9.17: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo aḍḍhā kulā pabbajito mahaddhanā mahābhogā … pe …
segments.mn95:9.18: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadā saṃpucchituṃ āgacchanti … pe …
segments.mn95:9.19: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ anekāni devatāsahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni … pe …
segments.mn95:9.20: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.mn95:9.21: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti … pe …
segments.mn95:9.22: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato … pe …[etthāpi dī. ni.1.304 aññānipi guṇapadānaṃ dissanti]
segments.mn95:9.23: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro saputtadāro pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato … pe …
segments.mn95:9.24: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo saputtadāro pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato … pe …
segments.mn95:9.25: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti saputtadāro pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato … pe …
segments.mn95:9.26: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo opāsādaṃ anuppatto opāsāde viharati uttarena opāsādaṃ devavane sālavane.
segments.mn95:9.27: Ye kho te samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ āgacchanti, atithī no te honti.
segments.mn95:9.28: Atithī kho panamhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā.
segments.mn95:9.29: Yampi samaṇo gotamo opāsādaṃ anuppatto opāsāde viharati uttarena opāsādaṃ devavane sālavane, atithimhākaṃ samaṇo gotamo.
segments.mn95:9.30: Atithi kho panamhehi sakkātabbo garukātabbo mānetabbo pūjetabbo.
segments.mn95:9.31: Imināpaṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:9.32: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.mn95:9.33: Ettake kho ahaṃ, bho, tassa bhoto gotamassa vaṇṇe pariyāpuṇāmi, no ca kho so bhavaṃ gotamo ettakavaṇṇo;
segments.mn95:9.35: Ekamekenapi tena [ekamekenapi bho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] aṅgena samannāgato na arahati, so, bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.mn95:9.36: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.
segments.mn95:9.37: Tena hi, bho, sabbeva mayaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:10.1: Atha kho caṅkī brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn95:10.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn95:11.1: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā vuddhehi vuddhehi brāhmaṇehi saddhiṃ kiñci kiñci kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā nisinno hoti.
segments.mn95:11.2: Tena kho pana samayena kāpaṭiko [kāpaṭhiko (sī. pī.), kāpadiko (syā. kaṃ.)] nāma māṇavo daharo vuttasiro soḷasavassuddesiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
segments.mn95:11.3: So vuddhānaṃ vuddhānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ bhagavatā saddhiṃ mantayamānānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opāteti.
segments.mn95:11.4: Atha kho bhagavā kāpaṭikaṃ māṇavaṃ apasādeti –
segments.mn95:11.5: “māyasmā bhāradvājo vuddhānaṃ vuddhānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mantayamānānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opātetu.
segments.mn95:11.7: Evaṃ vutte, caṅkī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn95:11.9: Kulaputto ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo, bahussuto ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo, paṇḍito ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo, pahoti ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun”ti.
segments.mn95:12.2: “addhā kho kāpaṭikassa [etadahosi “kāpaṭikassa (ka.)] māṇavassa tevijjake pāvacane kathā [kathaṃ (sī. ka.), kathaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] bhavissati.
segments.mn95:12.5: “yadā me samaṇo gotamo cakkhuṃ upasaṃharissati, athāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ pucchissāmī”ti.
segments.mn95:12.6: Atha kho bhagavā kāpaṭikassa māṇavassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena kāpaṭiko māṇavo tena cakkhūni upasaṃhāsi.
segments.mn95:12.10: Atha kho kāpaṭiko māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn95:12.11: “yadidaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ itihitihaparamparāya piṭakasampadāya, tattha ca brāhmaṇā ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchanti –
segments.mn95:13.1: “Kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇopi yo evamāha –
segments.mn95:13.5: “Kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekācariyopi, ekācariyapācariyopi, yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugāpi, yo evamāha –
segments.mn95:13.9: “Kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, yepi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti seyyathidaṃ – aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu,
segments.mn95:13.14: “Iti kira, bhāradvāja, natthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇopi yo evamāha –
segments.mn95:13.17: natthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekācariyopi ekācariyapācariyopi, yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugāpi, yo evamāha –
segments.mn95:13.20: yepi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti seyyathidaṃ – aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu, tepi na evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn95:13.23: “Seyyathāpi, bhāradvāja, andhaveṇi paramparāsaṃsattā purimopi na passati majjhimopi na passati pacchimopi na passati;
segments.mn95:13.24: evameva kho, bhāradvāja, andhaveṇūpamaṃ maññe brāhmaṇānaṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjati – purimopi na passati majjhimopi na passati pacchimopi na passati.
segments.mn95:13.26: nanu evaṃ sante brāhmaṇānaṃ amūlikā saddhā sampajjatī”ti?
segments.mn95:14.1: “Na khvettha, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā saddhāyeva payirupāsanti, anussavāpettha brāhmaṇā payirupāsantī”ti.
segments.mn95:14.2: “Pubbeva kho tvaṃ, bhāradvāja, saddhaṃ agamāsi, anussavaṃ idāni vadesi.
segments.mn95:14.3: Pañca kho ime, bhāradvāja, dhammā diṭṭheva dhamme dvedhā vipākā.
segments.mn95:14.6: ime kho, bhāradvāja, pañca dhammā diṭṭheva dhamme dvedhā vipākā.
segments.mn95:14.7: Api ca, bhāradvāja, susaddahitaṃyeva hoti, tañca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā;
segments.mn95:14.8: no cepi susaddahitaṃ hoti, tañca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
segments.mn95:14.9: Api ca, bhāradvāja, surucitaṃyeva hoti … pe …
segments.mn95:14.12: sunijjhāyitaṃyeva hoti, tañca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā;
segments.mn95:14.13: no cepi sunijjhāyitaṃ hoti, tañca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
segments.mn95:14.14: Saccamanurakkhatā, bhāradvāja, viññunā purisena nālamettha ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ –
segments.mn95:15.1: “Kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, saccānurakkhaṇā hoti, kittāvatā saccamanurakkhati?
segments.mn95:15.5: iti vadaṃ saccamanurakkhati [evameva sijjhatīti iti vā, taṃ saccamanurakkhati (ka.)], natveva tāva ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchati –
segments.mn95:15.6: ‘idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññan’ti ()[(ettāvatā kho bhāradvāja saccānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccamanurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānurakkhaṇaṃ paññāpema, na tveva tāva saccānubodho hoti)(sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.mn95:15.7: Ruci cepi, bhāradvāja, purisassa hoti … pe …
segments.mn95:15.8: anussavo cepi, bhāradvāja, purisassa hoti … pe …
segments.mn95:15.9: ākāraparivitakko cepi, bhāradvāja, purisassa hoti … pe …
segments.mn95:15.12: iti vadaṃ saccamanurakkhati, natveva tāva ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchati –
segments.mn95:15.14: Ettāvatā kho, bhāradvāja, saccānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccamanurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānurakkhaṇaṃ paññapema;
segments.mn95:16.1: “Ettāvatā, bho gotama, saccānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccamanurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānurakkhaṇaṃ pekkhāma.
segments.mn95:16.2: Kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, saccānubodho hoti, kittāvatā saccamanubujjhati?
segments.mn95:17.1: “Idha [idha kira (syā. kaṃ. ka.)], bhāradvāja, bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
segments.mn95:17.2: Tamenaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā tīsu dhammesu samannesati –
segments.mn95:17.3: lobhanīyesu dhammesu, dosanīyesu dhammesu, mohanīyesu dhammesu.
segments.mn95:17.4: Atthi nu kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā lobhanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi lobhanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya –
segments.mn95:17.6: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti?
segments.mn95:17.8: ‘natthi kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā lobhanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi lobhanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya –
segments.mn95:17.10: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya [dukkhāyāti (sabbattha)].
segments.mn95:17.11: Tathārūpo [tathā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] kho panimassāyasmato kāyasamācāro tathārūpo [tathā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vacīsamācāro yathā taṃ aluddhassa.
segments.mn95:17.12: Yaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo;
segments.mn95:18.1: “Yato naṃ samannesamāno visuddhaṃ lobhanīyehi dhammehi samanupassati tato naṃ uttari samannesati dosanīyesu dhammesu.
segments.mn95:18.2: Atthi nu kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā dosanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi dosanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya –
segments.mn95:18.4: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti?
segments.mn95:18.6: ‘natthi kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā dosanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi dosanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya –
segments.mn95:18.8: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
segments.mn95:18.9: Tathārūpo kho panimassāyasmato kāyasamācāro tathārūpo vacīsamācāro yathā taṃ aduṭṭhassa.
segments.mn95:18.10: Yaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo;
segments.mn95:19.1: “Yato naṃ samannesamāno visuddhaṃ dosanīyehi dhammehi samanupassati, tato naṃ uttari samannesati mohanīyesu dhammesu.
segments.mn95:19.2: Atthi nu kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā mohanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi mohanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya –
segments.mn95:19.4: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti?
segments.mn95:19.6: ‘natthi kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā mohanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi mohanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya –
segments.mn95:19.8: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tadatthāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
segments.mn95:19.9: Tathārūpo kho panimassāyasmato kāyasamācāro tathārūpo vacīsamācāro yathā taṃ amūḷhassa.
segments.mn95:19.10: Yaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo;
segments.mn95:20.1: “Yato naṃ samannesamāno visuddhaṃ mohanīyehi dhammehi samanupassati;
segments.mn95:20.2: atha tamhi saddhaṃ niveseti, saddhājāto upasaṅkamati, upasaṅkamanto payirupāsati, payirupāsanto sotaṃ odahati, ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, dhatānaṃ [dhāritānaṃ (ka.)] dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati, atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā sati chando jāyati, chandajāto ussahati, ussahitvā tuleti, tulayitvā padahati, pahitatto samāno kāyena ceva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.
segments.mn95:20.3: Ettāvatā kho, bhāradvāja, saccānubodho hoti, ettāvatā saccamanubujjhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānubodhaṃ paññapema;
segments.mn95:21.1: “Ettāvattā, bho gotama, saccānubodho hoti, ettāvatā saccamanubujjhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānubodhaṃ pekkhāma. Kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, saccānuppatti hoti, kittāvatā saccamanupāpuṇāti? Saccānuppattiṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:22.1: “Tesaṃye, bhāradvāja, dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ saccānuppatti hoti. Ettāvatā kho, bhāradvāja, saccānuppatti hoti, ettāvatā saccamanupāpuṇāti, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānuppattiṃ paññapemā”ti. “Ettāvatā, bho gotama, saccānuppatti hoti, ettāvatā saccamanupāpuṇāti, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānuppattiṃ pekkhāma.
segments.mn95:22.2: Saccānuppattiyā pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:22.3: Saccānuppattiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:22.6: Yasmā ca kho padahati tasmā saccamanupāpuṇāti.
segments.mn95:23.1: “Padhānassa pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:23.2: Padhānassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:23.5: Yasmā ca kho tuleti tasmā padahati.
segments.mn95:24.1: “Tulanāya pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:24.2: Tulanāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:24.5: Yasmā ca kho ussahati tasmā tuleti.
segments.mn95:25.1: “Ussāhassa pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:25.2: Ussāhassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:25.4: No cetaṃ chando jāyetha, nayidaṃ ussaheyya.
segments.mn95:25.5: Yasmā ca kho chando jāyati tasmā ussahati.
segments.mn95:26.1: “Chandassa pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:26.2: Chandassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:26.4: No cete dhammā nijjhānaṃ khameyyuṃ, nayidaṃ chando jāyetha.
segments.mn95:26.5: Yasmā ca kho dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti tasmā chando jāyati.
segments.mn95:27.1: “Dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:27.2: Dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:27.4: No cetaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkheyya, nayidaṃ dhammā nijjhānaṃ khameyyuṃ.
segments.mn95:27.5: Yasmā ca kho atthaṃ upaparikkhati tasmā dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
segments.mn95:28.1: “Atthūpaparikkhāya pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:28.2: Atthūpaparikkhāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:28.4: No cetaṃ dhammaṃ dhāreyya, nayidaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkheyya.
segments.mn95:28.5: Yasmā ca kho dhammaṃ dhāreti tasmā atthaṃ upaparikkhati.
segments.mn95:29.1: “Dhammadhāraṇāya pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:29.2: Dhammadhāraṇāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:29.4: No cetaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, nayidaṃ dhammaṃ dhāreyya.
segments.mn95:29.5: Yasmā ca kho dhammaṃ suṇāti tasmā dhammaṃ dhāreti.
segments.mn95:30.1: “Dhammassavanassa pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:30.2: Dhammassavanassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:30.4: No cetaṃ sotaṃ odaheyya, nayidaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya.
segments.mn95:30.5: Yasmā ca kho sotaṃ odahati tasmā dhammaṃ suṇāti.
segments.mn95:31.1: “Sotāvadhānassa pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:31.2: Sotāvadhānassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:31.4: No cetaṃ payirupāseyya, nayidaṃ sotaṃ odaheyya.
segments.mn95:31.5: Yasmā ca kho payirupāsati tasmā sotaṃ odahati.
segments.mn95:32.1: “Payirupāsanāya pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:32.2: Payirupāsanāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:32.5: Yasmā ca kho upasaṅkamati tasmā payirupāsati.
segments.mn95:33.1: “Upasaṅkamanassa pana, bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
segments.mn95:33.2: Upasaṅkamanassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā”ti.
segments.mn95:33.4: No cetaṃ saddhā jāyetha, nayidaṃ upasaṅkameyya.
segments.mn95:33.5: Yasmā ca kho saddhā jāyati tasmā upasaṅkamati.
segments.mn95:34.1: “Saccānurakkhaṇaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha, saccānurakkhaṇaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi;
segments.mn95:34.2: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca tena camha attamanā.
segments.mn95:34.3: Saccānubodhaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha, saccānubodhaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi;
segments.mn95:34.4: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca tena camha attamanā.
segments.mn95:34.5: Saccānuppattiṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha, saccānuppattiṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi;
segments.mn95:34.6: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca tena camha attamanā.
segments.mn95:34.7: Saccānuppattiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha, saccānuppattiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi;
segments.mn95:34.8: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca tena camha attamanā.
segments.mn95:34.9: Yaṃyadeva ca mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha taṃtadeva bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi;
segments.mn95:34.10: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca tena camha attamanā.
segments.mn95:34.11: Mayañhi, bho gotama, pubbe evaṃ jānāma –
segments.mn95:34.12: ‘ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādāpaccā, ke ca dhammassa aññātāro’ti?
segments.mn95:34.13: Ajanesi vata me bhavaṃ gotamo samaṇesu samaṇapemaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇapasādaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.
segments.mn95:35.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Tattha devavane sālavaneti tasmiṃ kira devatānaṃ balikammaṃ karīyati, tena taṃ devavanantipi sālavanantipi vuccati.
Opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasatīti opāsādanāmake brāhmaṇagāme vasati, abhibhavitvā vā āvasati, tassa sāmī hutvā yāya mariyādāya tattha vasitabbaṃ, tāya mariyādāya vasati.
Upasaggavasena panettha bhummatthe upayogavacanaṃ veditabbaṃ, tathassa anuppayogattāva sesapadesu.
Sattussadanti sattehi ussadaṃ ussannaṃ, bahujanaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ posāvaniyahatthiassamoramigādianekasattasamākiṇṇañcāti attho.

Yasmā pana so gāmo bahi āvijjhitvā jātena hatthiassādīnaṃ ghāsatiṇena ceva gehacchadanatiṇena ca sampanno, tathā dārukaṭṭhehi ceva gehasambhārakaṭṭhehi ca, yasmā cassa abbhantare vaṭṭacaturassādisaṇṭhānā bahū pokkharaṇiyo, jalajakusumavicittāni ca bahi anekāni taḷākāni vā udakassa niccabharitāneva honti, tasmā satiṇakaṭṭhodakanti vuttaṃ.
Ettāvatā yasmiṃ gāme brāhmaṇo setacchattaṃ ussāpetvā rājalīlāya vasati.
Kena dinnanti ce, raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ.
Brahmadeyyanti seṭṭhadeyyaṃ, chattaṃ ussāpetvā rājasaṅkhepena bhuñjitabbanti attho.
Atha vā rājabhogganti sabbaṃ chejjabhejjaṃ anusāsantena titthapabbatādīsu suṅkaṃ gaṇhantena setacchattaṃ ussāpetvā raññā hutvā bhuñjitabbaṃ.
Ettha raññā dinnattā rājadāyaṃ, dāyakarājadīpanatthaṃ panassa “raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnan”ti idaṃ vuttaṃ.
Brahmadeyyanti seṭṭhadeyyaṃ, yathā dinnaṃ na puna gahetabbaṃ hoti nissaṭṭhapariccattaṃ, evaṃ dinnanti attho.
Pubbe gāmassa anto agaṇā bahi nikkhamitvā gaṇā sampannāti gaṇībhūtā.
Khattaṃ āmantesīti khattā vuccati pucchitapañhabyākaraṇasamattho mahāmatto, taṃ āmantesi.
Nānāverajjakānanti nānāvidhesu rajjesu aññesu kāsikosalādīsu jātā vā nivasanti vā, tato vā āgatāti nānāverajjakā, tesaṃ nānāverajjakānaṃ.
“ayaṃ, caṅkī, uggatabrāhmaṇo, yebhuyyena ca aññe brāhmaṇā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, ayameva na gato.
Svāyaṃ sace tattha gamissati, addhā samaṇassa gotamassa āvaṭṭaniyā māyāya āvaṭṭito saraṇaṃ gamissati.
Tato etassāpi gehadvāre brāhmaṇānaṃ asannipāto bhavissati.
Handassa gamanantarāyaṃ karomā”ti sammantayitvā tattha agamaṃsu.
Taṃ sandhāya “atha kho te brāhmaṇā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Mātito ca pitito cāti, bhoto mātā brāhmaṇī, mātumātā brāhmaṇī, tassāpi mātā brāhmaṇī.
Pitā brāhmaṇo, pitupitā brāhmaṇo, tassapi pitā brāhmaṇoti.
Evaṃ bhavaṃ ubhato sujāto, mātito ca pitito ca.
Saṃsuddhagahaṇikoti saṃsuddhā te mātu gahaṇī, saṃsuddhā te mātu kucchīti attho.
Yāva sattamā pitāmahayugāti ettha pitu pitā pitāmaho, pitāmahassa yugaṃ pitāmahayugaṃ.
Abhilāpamattameva cetaṃ, atthato pana pitāmahova pitāmahayugaṃ.
Tato uddhaṃ sabbepi pubbapurisā pitāmahaggahaṇeneva gahitā.
Evaṃ yāva sattamo puriso, tāva saṃsuddhagahaṇiko.
Atha vā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādenāti dasseti.
Akkhittoti apanetha etaṃ, kiṃ imināti evaṃ akkhitto anavakkhitto.
Anupakkuṭṭhoti na upakuṭṭho, na akkosaṃ vā nindaṃ vā pattapubbo.
Jātivādena, itipi hīnajātiko esoti evarūpena vacanenāti attho.
Bhoto hi gehe pathaviyaṃ paṃsuvālikā viya bahu dhanaṃ, samaṇo pana gotamo adhano bhikkhāya udaraṃ pūretvā yāpetīti dassenti.
Evaṃ yaṃ yaṃ guṇaṃ vadanti, tassa tassa paṭipakkhavasena bhagavato aguṇaṃyeva dassemāti maññamānā vadanti.
Dassanīyoti divasampi passantānaṃ atittikaraṇato dassanayoggo, dassaneneva cittapasādajananato pāsādiko.
Pokkharatā vuccati sundarabhāvo, vaṇṇassa pokkharatā vaṇṇapokkharatā, tāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya, vaṇṇasampattiyāti attho.
Porāṇā pana pokkharanti sarīraṃ vadanti, vaṇṇaṃ vaṇṇameva.
Tesaṃ matena vaṇṇo ca pokkharañca vaṇṇapokkharāni, tesaṃ bhāvo vaṇṇapokkharatā.
Iti paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāyāti uttamaparisuddhena vaṇṇena ceva sarīrasaṇṭhānasampattiyā cāti attho.
Brahmavaṇṇīti seṭṭhavaṇṇī, parisuddhavaṇṇesupi seṭṭhena suvaṇṇavaṇṇeneva samannāgatoti attho.
Akhuddāvakāso dassanāyāti bhoto sarīre dassanassa okāso na khuddako mahā.
Sabbāneva te aṅgapaccaṅgāni dassanīyāneva, tāni cāpi mahantānevāti dīpeti.
Kālyāṇavācotiādīsu kalyāṇā sundarā parimaṇḍalapadabyañjanā vācā assāti kalyāṇavāco.
Ekaccassa hi kathentassa elaṃ galati, lālā vā paggharati, kheḷaphusitāni vā nikkhamanti, tassa vācā elagalā nāma hoti.

Evaṃ vutteti evaṃ tehi brāhmaṇehi vutte, caṅkī,“ime brāhmaṇā attano vaṇṇe vuccamāne atussanakasatto nāma natthi, vaṇṇamassa bhaṇitvā nivāressāmāti jātiādīhi mama vaṇṇaṃ vadanti, na kho pana me yuttaṃ attano vaṇṇe rajjituṃ.
Handāhaṃ etesaṃ vādaṃ bhinditvā samaṇassa gotamassa mahantabhāvaṃ ñāpetvā etesaṃ tattha gamanaṃ karomī”ti cintetvā tena hi, bho, mamāpi suṇāthātiādimāha.

Tattha yepi “ubhato sujāto”tiādayo attano guṇehi sadisā guṇā, tepi “ko cāhaṃ, ke ca samaṇassa gotamassa jātisampattiādayo guṇā”ti attano guṇehi uttaritareyeva maññamāno, itare pana ekanteneva bhagavato mahantabhāvadīpanatthaṃ pakāseti.

Mayameva arahāmāti evaṃ niyamento cettha idaṃ dīpeti – yadi guṇamahantatāya upasaṅkamitabbo nāma hoti, yathā sineruṃ upanidhāya sāsapo, mahāsamuddaṃ upanidhāya gopadakaṃ, sattasu mahāsaresu udakaṃ upanidhāya ussāvabindu paritto lāmako, evamevaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa jātisampattiādayo guṇe upanidhāya amhākaṃ guṇā parittā lāmakā, tasmā mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitunti.

Bhūmigatañca vehāsaṭṭhañcāti ettha rājaṅgaṇe ceva uyyāne ca sudhāmaṭṭhā pokkharaṇiyo sattaratanapūriṃ katvā bhūmiyaṃ ṭhapitaṃ dhanaṃ bhūmigataṃ nāma, pāsādaniyūhādayo pana pūretvā ṭhapitaṃ vehāsaṭṭhaṃ nāma.
Tathāgatassa pana jātadivaseyeva saṅkho elo uppalo puṇḍarīkoti cattāro nidhayo upagatā.
Tesu saṅkho gāvutiko, elo aḍḍhayojaniko, uppalo tigāvutiko puṇḍarīko yojanikoti.
Iti bhagavā pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajitoti veditabbo.

Tatridaṃ vatthuṃ – rājagahe kira aññataro brāhmaṇo “samaṇassa kira gotamassa pamāṇaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkā”ti sutvā bhagavato piṇḍāya pavisanakāle saṭṭhihatthaṃ veḷuṃ gahetvā nagaradvārassa bahi ṭhatvā sampatte bhagavati veḷuṃ gahetvā samīpe aṭṭhāsi, veḷu bhagavato jāṇumattaṃ pāpuṇi.
Punadivase dve veḷū ghaṭetvā samīpe aṭṭhāsi, bhagavā dvinnaṃ veḷūnaṃ upari dviveṇumattameva paññāyamāno,“brāhmaṇa, kiṃ karosī”ti āha?
“Brāhmaṇa, sacepi tvaṃ sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ pūretvā ṭhitaveḷuṃ ghaṭetvā āgamissasi, neva me pamāṇaṃ gahetuṃ sakkhissasi.
Na hi mayā cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni kappasatasahassañca tathā pāramiyo pūritā, yathā me paro pamāṇaṃ gaṇheyya, atulo brāhmaṇa, tathāgato appameyyo”ti vatvā dhammapade gāthamāha.

Aparampi vatthu – rāhu kira asurindo cattāri yojanasahassāni aṭṭha ca yojanasatāni ucco, bāhantaramassa dvādasayojanasatāni, hatthatalapādatalānaṃ puthulatā tīṇi yojanasatāni, aṅgulipabbāni paṇṇāsayojanāni, bhamukantaraṃ paṇṇāsayojanaṃ, nalāṭaṃ tiyojanasataṃ, sīsaṃ navayojanasataṃ.
“ahaṃ uccosmi, satthāraṃ onamitvā oloketuṃ na sakkhissāmī”ti na gacchati.
So ekadivasaṃ bhagavato vaṇṇaṃ sutvā “yathā kathañca olokessāmī”ti āgato.

Bhagavā tassa ajjhāsayaṃ viditvā “catūsu iriyāpathesu katarena dassemī”ti cintetvā “ṭhitako nāma nīcopi ucco viya paññāyati, nipannovassa attānaṃ dassessāmī”ti,“ānanda, gandhakuṭipariveṇe mañcakaṃ paññāpehī”ti vatvā tattha sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi.
Rāhu āgantvā nipannaṃ bhagavantaṃ gīvaṃ unnāmetvā nabhamajjhe puṇṇacandaṃ viya ulloketi.
Kimidaṃ asurindāti ca vutte, bhagavā onamitvā oloketuṃ na sakkhissāmīti na gacchinti.
Na mayā asurinda adhomukhena pāramiyo pūritā, uddhaggaṃ me katvā dānaṃ dinnanti.
Taṃ pana sīlaṃ ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ, tenāha ariyasīlīti.
Bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyoti bhagavato ekekāya dhammadesanāya caturāsītipāṇasahassāni aparimāṇāpi devamanussā maggaphalāmataṃ pivanti.
Khīṇakāmarāgoti ettha kāmaṃ bhagavato sabbepi kilesā khīṇā, brāhmaṇo pana te na jānāti, attano jānanaṭṭhāneyeva guṇaṃ katheti.
Vigatacāpalloti “pattamaṇḍanā cīvaramaṇḍanā senāsanamaṇḍanā imassa vā pūtikāyassa … pe … kelanā paṭikelanā”ti evaṃ vuttacāpalyavirahito.
Brahmaññāya pajāyāti sāriputtamoggallānamahākassapādibhedāya brāhmaṇapajāya.(Aviruddho hi so) etissāya pajāya purekkhāro.
Ayañhi pajā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ purato katvā caratīti attho.
Apica apāpapurekkhāroti na pāpupurekkhāro, na pāpaṃ purato katvā carati, pāpaṃ na icchatīti attho.
Brahmaññāya pajāya attanā saddhiṃ paṭiviruddhāyapi brāhmaṇapajāya aviruddho hitasukhatthikoyevāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Saṃpucchituṃ āgacchantīti khattiyapaṇḍitādayo ceva brāhmaṇagandhabbādayo ca pañhe abhisaṅkharitvā pucchissāmāti āgacchanti.
Tattha keci pucchāya vā dosaṃ vissajjanasampaṭicchane vā asamatthataṃ sallakkhetvā apucchitvāva tuṇhī nisīdanti, keci pucchanti, kesañci bhagavā pucchāya ussāhaṃ janetvā vissajjeti.
Evaṃ sabbesampi tesaṃ vimatiyo tīraṃ patvā mahāsamuddassa ūmiyo viya bhagavantaṃ patvāva bhijjanti.
Atithī no te hontīti te amhākaṃ āgantukā navakā pāhunakā hontīti attho.
Aparimāṇavaṇṇoti tathārūpeneva sabbaññunāpi appameyyavaṇṇo, pageva mādisenāti dasseti.

Imaṃ pana guṇakathaṃ sutvā te brāhmaṇā cintayiṃsu “yathā, caṅkī, samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, anomaguṇo so bhavaṃ gotamo, evaṃ tassa guṇe jānamānena kho pana iminā aticiraṃ adhivāsitaṃ, handa naṃ anuvattāmā”ti anuvattamānā “tena hi, bho”tiādimāhaṃsu.
Itihitiha paramparāyāti evaṃ kira evaṃ kirāti paramparabhāvena āgatanti dīpeti.
Sāvittiādīhi chandabandhehi ca vaggabandhehi ca sampādetvā āgatanti dasseti.
Samihitanti samupabyūḷhaṃ rāsikataṃ, piṇḍaṃ katvā ṭhapitanti attho.
Tadanugāyantīti etarahi brāhmaṇā taṃ tehi pubbe gītaṃ anugāyanti anusajjhāyanti vādenti.

Aṭṭhakotiādīni tesaṃ nāmāni, te kira dibbena cakkhunā oloketvā parūpaghātaṃ akatvā kassapasammāsambuddhassa bhagavato pāvacanena saha saṃsandetvā mante ganthesuṃ, aparāpare pana brāhmaṇā pāṇātipātādīni pakkhipitvā tayo vede bhinditvā buddhavacanena saddhiṃ viruddhe akaṃsu.
Ekena hi cakkhumatā gahitayaṭṭhiyā koṭiṃ eko andho gaṇhāti, taṃ andhaṃ añño, taṃ aññoti evaṃ paṇṇāsa saṭṭhi andhā paṭipāṭiyā ghaṭitā andhaveṇīti vuccati.
Paramparāsaṃsattāti aññamaññaṃ laggā, yaṭṭhiggāhakenapi cakkhumatā virahitāti attho.

Eko kira dhutto andhagaṇaṃ disvā “asukasmiṃ nāma gāme khajjabhojjaṃ sulabhan”ti ussāhetvā tehi “tattha no sāmi nehi, idaṃ nāma te demā”ti vutte lañjaṃ gahetvā antarāmagge maggā okkamma mahantaṃ gacchaṃ anuparigantvā purimassa hatthena pacchimassa kacchaṃ gaṇhāpetvā “kiñci kammaṃ atthi, gacchatha tāva tumhe”ti vatvā palāyi.
Te divasampi gantvā maggaṃ avindamānā “kahaṃ, bho, cakkhumā kahaṃ maggo”ti paridevitvā maggaṃ avindamānā tattheva mariṃsu.
Pañca khoti pāḷiāgatesu dvīsu aññepi evarūpe tayo pakkhipitvā vadati.

Nālametthāti, bhāradvāja, saccaṃ anurakkhissāmīti paṭipannena viññunā “yaṃ mayā gahitaṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti ettha ekaṃseneva niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ nālaṃ na yuttanti upari pucchāya maggaṃ vivaritvā ṭhapesi.
Idha, bhāradvāja, bhikkhūti jīvakasutte (ma. ni.2.51 ādayo) viya mahāvacchasutte (ma. ni.2.193 ādayo) viya ca attānaññeva sandhāya vadati.
Nijjhānaṃ khamantīti olokanaṃ khamanti, idha sīlaṃ kathitaṃ, idha samādhīti evaṃ upaṭṭhahantīti attho.
Kāyena ceva paramasaccanti sahajātanāmakāyena ca nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti, paññāya ca kilese nibbijjhitvā tadeva vibhūtaṃ pākaṭaṃ karonto passati.
Tesaṃyevāti heṭṭhā vuttānaṃ dvādasannaṃ, evaṃ dīghaṃ maggavādaṃ anulometi, tasmā nāyamattho.
Tañhi phalasacchikiriyasaṅkhātāya saccānuppattiyā bahukāraṃ, magge asati phalābhāvatoti.
Ajjhāvasatīti ettha adhi-ā-saddānaṃ anatthantarataṃ hadaye katvā āha “vasatī”ti.
Idāni tesaṃ atthavisesabhāvitaṃ dassento “abhibhavitvā vā āvasatī”tiādimāha.
Upa-anu-adhi-iti-evaṃ-pubbake vasanakiriyayāṭṭhāne upayogavacanameva pāpuṇātīti saddavidū icchantīti āha “lakkhaṇaṃ saddasatthato pariyesitabban”ti.
Tathā hi vuttaṃ “upasaggavasena panettha bhummatthe upayogavacanaṃ veditabban”ti.
Ussadatā nāmettha bahulatāti taṃ bahulataṃ dassetuṃ “bahujanan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Rājanīhārena paribhuñjitabbato uddhaṃ paribhogalābhassa seṭṭhadeyyatā nāma natthīti āha –
Yo koci viññūnaṃ icchito pañho, tassa pucchitassa yāthāvato kathanasamattho pucchitapañhabyākaraṇasamattho.

“Ubhato sujāto”ti (dī. ni. ṭī.1.303; a. ni. ṭī.3.5.134) ettake vutte yehi kehici dvīhi bhāgehi sujātatā viññāyeyya, sujātasaddo ca “sujāto cārudassano”tiādīsu (ma. ni.2.399; su. ni.553; theragā.818) ārohapariṇāhasampattipariyāyoti jātivaseneva sujātataṃ vibhāvetuṃ “mātito ca pitito cā”ti vuttaṃ.
Anorasaputtavasenapi loke mātupitusamaññā dissati, idha panassa orasaputtavaseneva icchīyatīti dassetuṃ “saṃsuddhagahaṇīko”ti vuttaṃ.
Pitā ca mātā ca pitaro, pitūnaṃ pitaro pitāmahā, tesaṃ yugo pitāmahayugo, tasmā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugāti evamettha attho daṭṭhabbo.
Yugasaddo cettha ekasesanayena daṭṭhabbo “yugo ca yugo ca yugā”ti.
Evañhi tattha tattha dvinnaṃ gahitameva hoti.
Ettha ca ubhato … pe … pitāmahayugāti etena brāhmaṇassa yonidosābhāvo dassito saṃsuddhagahaṇikabhāvakittanato.
Ayuttasaṃsaggampi hi paṭicca sattā akkosaṃ labhanti.
Sā panassa issaratā vibhavasampattipaccayā pākaṭā jātāti aḍḍhatāpariyāyabhāvena vadanto “aḍḍhoti issaro”ti āha.
Sarīranti sannivesavisiṭṭho karacaraṇagīvāsīsādi avayavasamudāyo, so ca saṇṭhānamukhena gayhatīti “paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāyāti paramāya … pe … sampattiyā cā”ti vuttaṃ.
Sabbavaṇṇesu suvaṇṇavaṇṇova uttamoti vuttaṃ “seṭṭhena suvaṇṇavaṇṇena samannāgato”ti.
Tathā hi buddhā cakkavattino ca suvaṇṇavaṇṇāva honti.
Imameva hi atthaṃ sandhāyāha “mahābrahmuno sarīrasadisena sarīrena samannāgato”ti.
Akhuddāvakāso dassanāyāti ārohapariṇāhasampattiyā avayavapāripūriyā ca dassanāya okāso na khuddako.
Yamaniyamalakkhaṇaṃ sīlamassa atthīti sīlavā, taṃ panassa rattaññutāya vuddhaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ sīlaṃ assa atthīti vuddhasīlī, tena ca sabbadā samāyogato vuḍḍhasīlena samannāgato.
Pañcasīlamattameva sandhāya vadanti tato paraṃ sīlassa tattha abhāvato tesañca ajānanato.
Ṭhānakaraṇasampattiyā sikkhāsampattiyā ca katthacipi anūnatāya parimaṇḍalapadāni byañjanāni akkharāni etissāti parimaṇḍalapadabyañjanā.
Atha vā pajjati attho etenāti padaṃ, nāmādi, yathādhippetamatthaṃ byañjetīti byañjanaṃ vākyaṃ, tesaṃ paripuṇṇatāya parimaṇḍalapadabyañjanā.
Pūreti ca purimasmiṃ atthe ādhāre bhummaṃ, dutiyasmiṃ visaye.
Ādimajjhapariyosānaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvāti iminā cassa vācāya atthapāripūriṃ vadanti.
Na hi buddhānaṃ guṇehi sabbathā sadisā kecipi guṇā aññesu labbhanti.
Sīhaseyyaṃ kappesīti yathā rāhu asurindo āyāmato vitthārato ubbedhato ca bhagavato rūpakāyassa paricchedaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonto sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi.
Katthaci caturāsīti pāṇasahassāni katthaci aparimāṇāpi devamanussā yasmā catuvīsatiyā ṭhānesu asaṅkhyeyyā aparimeyyā maggaphalāmataṃ pivanti.
Apāpapurekkhāroti apāpehi purakkharīyati, na vā pāpaṃ purato karotītipi apāpapurekkhāroti imamatthaṃ dassetuṃ “apāpe nava lokuttaradhamme”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Brahmani bhavā, brahmuno vā hitā garukaraṇādinā, brahmānaṃ vā maggaṃ jānātīti brahmaññā, tassā brahmaññāya pajāya.
Tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadāti ettha rajjaṃ raṭṭhaṃ rājanti rājāno etenāti katvā.
Tadekadesabhūtā padesā pana janapado janā pajjanti ettha sukhajīvikaṃ pāpuṇantīti katvā.
Tathābhūto ca tattha pesitā hotīti vuttaṃ “pavesetī”ti.
Sudde bahi katvā raho sāsitabbaṭṭhena mantā eva taṃtaṃatthapaṭipattihetutāya padanti mantapadaṃ vedaṃ.
Sāvittiādīhi chandabandhehi vaggabandhehi cāti gāyattīādīhi ajjhāyānuvākādīhi chandabandhehi ca vaggabandhehi ca.
Sajjhāyitanti gāyanavasena sajjhāyitaṃ, taṃ pana padeneva icchitanti āha “padasampattivasenā”ti.
Rāsikatanti iruvedayajuvedasāmavedādivasena, tatthāpi paccekaṃ mantabrahmādivasena ajjhāyānuvākādivasena rāsikataṃ.

Dibbena cakkhunā oloketvāti dibbacakkhuparibhaṇḍena yathākammūpagañāṇena sattānaṃ kammassakataṃ, paccakkhato dassanaṭṭhena dibbacakkhusadisena pubbenivāsañāṇena atītakappe brāhmaṇānaṃ mantajjhenavidhiñca oloketvā.
Pāvacanena saha saṃsandetvāti kassapasammāsambuddhassa yaṃ vacanaṃ vaṭṭasannissitaṃ, tena saha aviruddhaṃ katvā.
Na hi tesaṃ vivaṭṭasannissito attho paccakkho hoti.
Pakkhipitvāti aṭṭhakādīhi ganthitamantapadesu kilesasannissitapadānaṃ tattha tattha pade pakkhipanaṃ katvā.
Viruddhe akaṃsūti brāhmaṇadhammikasuttā dīsu (khu. ni. brāhmaṇadhammikasuttaṃ) āgatanayeneva saṃkilesikatthadīpanato paccanīkabhūte akaṃsu.
Purimassāti maṇḍalākārena ṭhitāya andhaveṇiyā sabbapurimassa hatthena sabbapacchimassa kacchaṃ gaṇhāpetvā.
Cakkhussa anāgatabhavaṃ ñatvā yathāakkantaṭṭhāneyeva anupatitvā akkamanaṃva sallakkhetvā “kahaṃ cakkhumā kahaṃ maggo”ti pariveditvā.
Evarūpeti yathā saddhānussavā, evarūpe eva paccakkhagāhinoti attho.
Upari pucchāya maggaṃ vivaritvā ṭhapesi saccānurakkhāya ñātukāmatāya uppāditattā.

Passati hi bhagavā – mayā “saccamanurakkhatā … pe … niṭṭhaṃ gantun”ti vutte saccānurakkhaṇaṃ ñātukāmo māṇavo “kittāvatā”tiādinā pucchissati, tassa taṃ vissajjetvā saccānubodhe pucchāya avasaraṃ datvā tassa upanissaye upakāradhamme kathessāmīti.
“yaṃ kho panāyamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho”tiādi.
Yathā vā rūpādidhammā lobhanīyā, evaṃ lobhoti āha “lobhanīyesu dhammesūti lobhadhammesū”ti.
“yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisatī”ti (dī. ni.2.400; ma. ni.1.133; vibha.203).
Olokananti evametanti yathāsabhāvato paññācakkhunā daṭṭhabbataṃ khamanti, tañca mahantassa maṇino pajjalantassa viya āvikatvā atthassa citte upaṭṭhānanti āha “idhā”tiādi.
Vāyamatītiādito catunnampi vīriyānaṃ vasena vāyāmaṃ parakkamaṃ karoti.
Maggapadhānaṃ padahatīti maggāvahaṃ maggapariyāpannañca sammappadhānaṃ padahati, padahanavasena taṃ paripūreti.
Sabbamidaṃ thāvarajaṅgamaṃ purisakataṃ, tasmā yaṃ kiñci katvā attā posetabbo rakkhitabboti lokāyatanissito nītimaggo ghoṭamukhakanto, tasmā āha “etassa kira jānanasippe”tiādi.
Devalokapariyāpannadhanaṃ manussānaṃ upakappapuññābhāvato pubbe attanā nihitadhanaṃ “asuke cā”ti ācikkhitvā gato.
